title.romaji: Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo?: Onsen Manyuuki
title.english: Problem Children Are Coming From Another World, Aren't They? OVA

Media.description:
Fleeing through the forest, Hifumi tries to outrun a band of thugs. Accidentally falling off a cliff she lands in the arms of Sakamaki Izayoi, who is accompanied by Kasukabe You and Kudou Asuka. And so the No Names protect Hifumi from the members of a community of slave traders using Deen. As it turns out Hifumi has the special ability to find water sources.

At the presently dried up hot springs, the gang joins up with Kuro Usagi, Lili and Letitia. Now it is up to them to win another Gift Game... the prize: a luxurious soak in the hot springs.

OVA bundled with the eighth volume of the light novel.

title.romaji: Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo?
title.english: Problem Children Are Coming From Another World, Aren't They?

node.description:
Izayoi Sakamaki, Asuka Kudou, and You Kasugabe have tremendous psychic powers and are bored with the regular world. An envelope arrives for each person, and when each opens their envelope, they are stunned to see the scenery around them change to a world they had never encountered before. They've been summoned by the Black Rabbit to help the community "No Name" to overthrow the Devil King.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
